details:
Q1. Which part of the repo should be improved? Include the exact phase, workflow, script, file, or consumer repo if you know it.
Choices:
A. A pipeline workflow/script in this repo (clarify, plan, implement, review, orchestrate, validate, etc.) — name the phase or file (RECOMMENDED)
B. Repository documentation or configuration in this repo — name the file or section
C. A consumer repo wrapper/copied workflow — name the repo and file
Q2. What is the main problem today? Include one concrete symptom, example, or missing behavior.
Choices:
A. Something is broken, flaky, or failing — include the job/log/symptom (RECOMMENDED)
B. A behavior or capability is missing — describe the gap (RECOMMENDED)
C. It works, but you want a quality improvement (for example cost, speed, clarity, or maintainability) — state the pain
Q3. What should count as “done”? Give the clearest acceptance signal you have.
Choices:
A. A before/after example of the desired behavior or output (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific workflow/job/check that should pass or stop failing
C. A specific file, doc, config, or visible output that should change
